messages:
ana: Short thread We need to finalize the 'Pack Slate' pricing pilot specs today: priority routing, reserved throughput with burst credits, and per-route caps. 20m sync at 2?

sam: 2pm works. From product: propose priority SLOs p50<=30ms, p95<=120ms for short composer prompts. Must include documented fallback.

liz: Add quality guardrail: <5% regression on composer eval prompts during pilot.

mohit: Implementation note: soft-priority router weights for GA; dedicated pools for enterprise. Soft priority infra estimate +20%.

ralph: Sales wants a paid pilot not free. Suggest 25% discount with 3-month min commit to capture usage signals.

legal: I will draft a Pilot Addendum (timeboxed, liability limits, conversion option) and flag language to avoid 'guaranteed' unless we attach credits.

ops-bot: Uploaded request: https://internal.redwood/exports/top-routes-q4.csv and perf traces.

ana: Action list: book sync (ana), liz propose eval set EOD, sam draft pricing table tomorrow, mohit infra estimate 24h, legal pilot addendum 48h, ops-bot attach traces.

sam: Suggested public wording: "Priority routing with documented SLO and fallback to standard tier." Keeps expectations clean.

mohit: Router snippet for RFC: ```yaml
route_priority: soft
weights:
  pack_slate: 1.6
  standard: 1.0
burst_window_seconds: 600
max_burst_tokens: 150000
```

ana: Post-sync I'll update RFC and schedule T+3 follow-up to review pilot contract drafts.
